build_roi_embed_head: build a RoIEmbedHead instance with configurable conv and fc layers for multi-object tracking
extract_roi_features: extract embedding features from ROI proposals using the RoIEmbedHead extract_feat method
compute_tracking_loss: compute tracking loss by matching ROI features between key and reference frames
get_tracking_targets: get ground truth tracking targets and weights from sampling results and instance IDs
predict_similarity_logits: predict similarity logits between current and previous ROI features for tracking
